attchmntText: Indo Tech Transformers Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half yearly ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Indo Tech Transformers Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on November 12, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 23,848 lakhs, with a profit after tax of Rs. 2,613 lakhs. For the six-month period, revenue was Rs. 46,637 lakhs, and profit after tax was Rs. 5,183 lakhs. Earnings per share for the quarter was Rs. 24.60, and Rs. 48.80 for the half year. The statutory auditors issued an unqualified report on the limited review. The meeting commenced at 11.00 A.M. IST and concluded at 01.08 P.M. IST.

attchmntText: Indo Tech Transformers Limited has informed the Exchange about Receipt of Prestigious Order for Supply of Power Transformers for a Steel Plant in the Eastern Region of India
